en: Colorized early-20th‑century streetscape showing a quiet residential street lined with large villas and fenced gardens. A gently curving road runs into the distance with telegraph poles along the sidewalk and low hills or vineyards in the background. Printed titling at the top identifies the scene as Radebeul, Rosenstrasse. Publisher information appears vertically along the left and right margins.
